name: HoloDentist
summary:
HoloDentist is a Mixed Reality (XR) platform for digital dentistry that enables clinicians, dental technicians, and patients to visualize and interact with 3D dental data, including intraoral scans, CBCT images, and digital treatment plans, within an immersive environment.

The platform supports treatment planning, patient communication, education, and remote collaboration by allowing multiple users to review and discuss clinical cases in real time, regardless of their location.
